summary.text: Roy Klopfenstein is a Republican state representative and farmer from Paulding County who has represented Ohio House District 82 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served 10 years as a Paulding County commissioner, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Klopfenstein lives in Paulding County and has worked as a farmer.

He served as a state committee member of the USDA Farm Service Agency, joined the Ohio Soybean Association, Ohio Corn and Wheat Growers Association and Ohio Farm Bureau, and chaired the Paulding County Extension Advisory Committee and the Ohio State University State Extension Advisory Committee.
He succeeded Craig Riedel in District 82 and won re-election on November 5, 2024 over Democrat Magdalene Markward.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Agriculture Committee and a member of the Local Government and Transportation committees.
Maddux McCray (D) and Christopher Elder (L) are on the November 3, 2026 ballot with him.
